profile.headline: Senior Fullstack Engineer at Roblox
profile.summary: I'm a Software Engineer with a degree in Computer Science from University of California, Irvine and over 10 years of programming experience and 5 years of professional web development.

positions.title: Lead Engineer
positions.description:
FOX Content Delivery Platforms - [React, Redux, Jenkins, Jest]
- Lead team of 7 engineers updating and maintaining Fox.com & Nation.FoxNews.com streaming platforms
- Provide technical guidance on feature development from design to implementation
- Drive improvements to code base health and methodology with an emphasis on performance
- Pilot flow of development code through QA, Staging, and release into Production environments

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
FOX Content Delivery Platforms - [React, Redux, Jest]
- Continuously integrate features and fixes to Fox.com, Nation.FoxNews.com, NationalGeographic.com/tv and other Fox streaming subsidiaries using React/Redux
- Markedly decreased application load times through improved architecture, render optimization, and dependency minimization
- Contribute to Open Source projects to solve unique problems in product requirements
- Improved code stability through implementation of Jest testing and increased code coverage
- Delivered product updates through one week scrum sprints in three teams simultaneously

Growth & Optimization - [Javascript, Optimizely, Segment, Tealium]
- Improved site speed and SEO optimization through static builds, reduced API overhead and load time, meta tag building, and other processes
- Built Optimizely A/B tests to verify growth hypotheses that lead to marked increases in conversions and retention
- Integrated Segment to track user actions, profile state, and history on all platforms for analysis of user behavior

positions.title: Lead Software Engineer
positions.description:
Founding member of core development team for Supply Chain Management and Logistics Management software. [React, Redux, React-Native]
- Lead a team of 8 engineers through product design, production, and release
- Independently developed Point Of Sales front end solution for system responsible for $2
million in sales monthly
- Developed mid-size web application through the use of React, Redux, React-Router as well as dozens of independent open source libraries
- Mentored several interns through the process of learning code/framework of product
- Maintained code base of 100+ components, 30+ libraries, and 4 git repository contributors
- Gathered client requirements and translated them into milestones and development sprints

positions.title: Software Engineering Intern
positions.description:
Workspace Optimization - [Javascript, JSON, HTML, CSS, Polymer]
- Independently   created   a   web   application   module   to   work   with   company   software   using
JavaScript/JSON/HTML/CSS   and   Google   Polymer   framework
- Utilized   open   source   code   to   parse   specially   formatted   Excel   documents   for   company   data
- Documented   both   module   software   requirements   and   module   testing   procedures
